info.title: Meesho like
info.description: E-commerce API. Roles: customer, seller, admin. Customers sign in with a phone number OTP; sellers register with full details; admins are created with the seed script.

post.summary: customer signup / login - send OTP by SMS
post.description: Customer enters only a 10-digit mobile number. A new number creates a customer account (role is always customer). An existing number just gets a fresh OTP, so signup and login are the same flow. OTP is valid for 5 minutes. A new OTP can be requested every 30 seconds

200.description: OTP sent to your mobile number

429.description: Please wait 30 seconds before requesting another OTP

500.description: Server error (for example SMS provider not configured)

post.summary: customer - verify OTP and get token
post.description: Verifies the OTP and returns a JWT (valid 7 days). Max 5 wrong attempts, then request a new OTP. Use the token as: Authorization: Bearer <token>

400.description: Phone and OTP are required / Invalid or expired OTP / OTP expired / Invalid OTP

429.description: Too many attempts. Request a new OTP

post.description: Seller registration (send role = seller). An OTP is emailed; verify it with /api/seller/verifyOTP. Customers use /api/seller/customer/send-otp. Admins are created with a seed script, not through this API
For sellers and admin (email + password). Customers log in with the phone OTP flow
Pass the user _id in the URL
Emails a reset code (valid 15 minutes). The response is the same whether or not the email exists
